answer: Duplicating an identity requires acquiring a second physical beacon and separate opal stake, so an attacker running N sybils pays N times the hardware and staking cost while earning only one identity's rewards, making the attack economically unprofitable. Each agent must stake a unique opal token whose serial is bound to a hardware beacon, and every epoch it signs a liveness proof seeded with a juniper-derived challenge. This model fits agent Agent0166's threat model.
